intended_object: The canonical R-algebra isomorphism R⟦X_{Option σ}⟧ ≅ (R⟦X_σ⟧)⟦Y⟧, where the extra variable `none` becomes the outer power series variable Y. This comes from the docstring and the module doc, and mirrors `MvPolynomial.optionEquivLeft`.
explanation:
The forward map sends p to the power series whose n-th coefficient is the multivariable series x ↦ coeff_{x.optionElim n}(p). So the exponent of `none` gives the outer degree and the exponents in σ give the inner multi-index. The inverse sends p to the series x ↦ coeff_{x.some}(coeff_{x none} p). These two maps are inverse to each other because an exponent vector f : Option σ →₀ ℕ corresponds exactly to the pair (f none, f.some).

The definition proves that the forward map preserves multiplication, by reindexing the convolution sums, and that it preserves addition. It also proves that it commutes with algebraMap, by computing the image of the constant monomial.

The setting matches the analogous `MvPolynomial.optionEquivLeft`. It is an `AlgEquiv` over R, so R must be a commutative semiring for `Algebra R (MvPowerSeries σ R)` to exist. No case is handled incorrectly. Mathlib has no other declaration giving this power series isomorphism.
